method: Original downloaded binary; installed Rive Canvas advanced WASM. Native typed input state changes and Canvas2D vector draw geometry recorded. Product appearance is reviewed separately in browser.
limitations: Canvas2D harness reports no WebGL support; image meshes cannot be verified by this harness.
Work-area clip phases and full absolute timeline frames were sampled on fresh artboards. Geometry signatures do not establish product quality.
Frame draw indices are local drawing order, not stable source component IDs.

robotBoundsSampled.method: Every integer frame0..72 at24fps for all five body clips; Theme Light applied first; excludes native button-row drawings whose minY is389 or more.

closedEyeFrames.limitation: The closed pose is embedded in each full-body timeline. Holding its phase also holds body and float; it is not an independently bound eye property.

headAudit.idleVersusReceiveLoop: Identical bounded head-region vector signatures at all five sampled frames
headAudit.independentNodeControl: Only root artboard name resolved through node/bone/rootBone/transformComponent among all ASCII names found in original binary.

speakingTrace.description: Small white visor trace measured in talking loop. Visual legibility and usefulness as speaking are separate judgments.
